description.value: Furlong Bay is the main section of Lakelse Lake Provincial Park, set on a sandy lakeshore framed by the Kitimat Mountain Range and surrounded by old-growth cedar, hemlock, and Sitka spruce; showers, device charging, and on-site kayak and SUP rentals make it a well-equipped summer base. Access is straightforward via paved Highway 37 about 20 km south of Terrace.

address.value: Furlong Bay Campground, Kitimat-Stikine, BC, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The BC Parks website confirms Furlong Bay Campground is an active provincial park campground with 156 sites on Lakelse Lake, noting a covered picnic shelter, ice cream stand, Visitor Centre, and amphitheatre. Reservations are confirmed through the BC Parks frontcountry camping system (camping.bcparks.ca). The operator phone number (+1-250-638-8490 for Northwest Escapes Ltd.) appears in OSM but is not listed on the BC Parks website; the website's contact page directs users to operator contact info on individual park pages, but that subpage was not in the fetched content, so the phone cannot be confirmed.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Well-established 156-site BC Parks provincial campground on a scenic lake with confirmed reservations, covered shelter, and on-site food; a clear benefit to touring cyclists passing through the North Coast corridor.
